summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#434](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/434)** — Fixes two long-standing `OverlayTiming` bugs. `StartBackgroundEventIndex` was reapplied every event, so the same background events were overlaid repeatedly. `AllowReusingBackgroundFiles` was never enforced. Jobs that silently relied on wrap-around reuse of background files will now fail unless reuse is explicitly allowed.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#122](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/122)** — Removes the legacy `ACTSSeededCKFTrackingAlg` together with `ACTSAlgBase`, `GeometryIdMappingTool` and `GeometryIdSelector`. Users should migrate to `CKFTrackingAlg`; v00-05 is the last tag containing the old algorithm.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/113)** — GNNTrackFinding now uses native Gaudi list properties instead of comma-separated strings, and old string-style configurations are rejected at configuration time. The PR also removes edge deduplication from edge ordering and `CCAndWalkTrackBuilding`, and drops unused ONNX helper APIs.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#115](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/115)** — GNNTrackFinding now requires `EdgeFeatureScales` with a phi scale of π whenever `ComputeEdgeFeatures` is set. Any other configuration silently produced wrong `dphi`, `phislope` and `rphislope` edge features, and now fails in `initialize()`.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes a `TracksFromGenParticles` bug where `ExtrapolateToECal=False` left the ECAL geometry uninitialized but still used it. As a result, tracks could randomly receive calorimeter track states extrapolated with garbage geometry. Extrapolation now only runs when requested, and geometry lookup failures return an error instead of throwing.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/102)** — Refactors `GGTFTrackFinder` and fixes wire-hit bookkeeping that associated hits from multiple wire collections with the wrong collection. Noise/unclustered hits (cluster ID ≤ 0) no longer produce an output track, so `GGTFTracks` no longer contains the "cluster 0" track; other tracks are unchanged in validation.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — Corrects units in the GENFIT helix-to-Cartesian Jacobian and the z0 conversion, and avoids a singular initial z0 covariance. Fitted states are now propagated with GENFIT's native extrapolation to the IP and to the first/last hits, which changes the EDM4hep track states produced by the track fitter.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The Delphes-to-EDM4hep converter now assigns the pion mass to non-lepton tracks so that energy, mass and momentum are consistent. It also sets the PDG ID for tracks and leptons, so analysts no longer need to infer particle identity from the mass. Reconstructed particle and jet four-momenta change slightly in Delphes-based analyses.

- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#286](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/286)** — Rewrites `PairCaloClustersPi0` as a maximum graph matching (Boost.Graph, O(N³)) in place of an exponential exhaustive search that exhausted memory on hadronic events. Results match the old algorithm apart from output ordering; π⁰ candidates are now sorted.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#41](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/41)** — Adds 2D (θ, energy)-binned energy correction plugins for EM (`PhotonEMNonLinearity`) and hadronic (`HadronicThetaEnergyBinned`) clusters. The corrections are applied inside Pandora before PFO building, so cluster, PFO and jet energies stay consistent. All new options default to off, so existing configurations are unaffected.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1689](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1689)** — The DDG4 EDM4hep reader now correctly handles the new MDI synchrotron-radiation files, which contain parentless photons. Those photons are now started in Geant4 at their vertex rather than at their endpoint.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — Adds a digitization/reconstruction configuration and a CTest for IDEA option 2 (IDEA_o2_v01), based on the reduced geometry and aligned with the IDEA_o1 tracking and validation setup.
